name: com.htmlannotate/htmlannotate
title: HTMLAnnotate
description: Share pages for review, then read, reply to and resolve comments. Sign in to keep pages.

tools.name: share_html
tools.description: Publish a complete HTML page (for example a landing page, prototype or one-pager you just wrote) to HTMLAnnotate and get a review link. Anyone with the link can open the page and click any heading, button or image to leave a comment pinned to it, with no account. Pass the whole page as one self-contained HTML document (inline the CSS; images as URLs or data URIs). Returns the review link to send to the client and a private manage link for the owner.

html.description: The full HTML document, starting with <!doctype html> or <html>.

title.description: Optional short name for the page, used in the file name.

notify_email.description: Optional. The user's email, so HTMLAnnotate emails them when someone comments. Ask the user before sharing whether they want this.

tools.name: share_url
tools.description: Turn a public web address (a published site, staging link or deploy preview) into an HTMLAnnotate review link where people click any element and comment on it. The page must open in a browser without signing in.

url.description: The page address, for example https://example.com

notify_email.description: Optional. The user's email, so HTMLAnnotate emails them when someone comments. Ask the user before sharing whether they want this.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Read every comment on an HTMLAnnotate page: what each reviewer said, which element it is pinned to (with a CSS selector), the screen size, the page version it was left on, suggested text changes and replies. Use it when the user asks what their client said, or wants you to make the requested changes. Needs the page's private manage link (returned by share_html or share_url, or pasted by the user).

include_resolved.description: Also list comments already marked resolved. Default false.

include_screenshots.description: Also return the reviewers' screenshots as images (up to 4 per call, in comment order). Default false. Use get_comment to see one comment's screenshot.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a reply under one comment on an HTMLAnnotate page, as the page owner. Everyone in that thread gets an email. Confirm the wording with the user first.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page.

number.description: The comment number, as shown by get_comments (for example 3 for #3).

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark a comment on an HTMLAnnotate page as resolved (done), or reopen it. Use after the requested change has been made. Everyone in the thread gets an email when it is resolved.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page.

number.description: The comment number, as shown by get_comments.

resolved.description: true to resolve (default), false to reopen.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Replace an HTML page on HTMLAnnotate with a new version, on the same review link, so the client sees the update without a new link. The new version starts with no comments; earlier versions keep theirs. Use after making the changes from get_comments. Needs the manage link. Only for pages shared as HTML, not live websites.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page.

notify_reviewers.description: Email everyone who commented that a new version is ready. Ask the user first.

note.description: Optional short note for that email, like what changed.

version_name.description: Optional short name for the new version, like "Shorter hero, new photo". Shown in the version menu.

tools.name: get_comment
tools.description: Read one comment in full: what the reviewer said, the element it is pinned to, its status, priority, labels, assignee and replies, plus the screenshot of what the reviewer saw, returned as an image. Use it when the user asks about a specific comment, or to look at the screenshot before making a change.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

include_screenshot.description: Return the reviewer's screenshot as an image. Default true.

tools.name: get_page_html
tools.description: Get the HTML of a page shared as HTML, exactly as it was uploaded, so you can make the changes reviewers asked for and publish the result with update_page. Call it before editing when you don't already have the page's code in this conversation. Defaults to the latest version. Pages over about 400 KB come back in parts: call again with the next_offset it gives. For a live website it returns the site's current HTML for reference only, since the site is changed in its own code or builder. PDFs have no HTML.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

version.description: Optional. The version to read, as shown by list_versions. Default: the latest.

offset.description: Optional. Where to start, for a big page: the next_offset from the previous call. Default 0.

tools.name: get_health_check
tools.description: Read the page's latest health check: a score (how many checks passed), and each problem with where it is on the page in plain words (like "In the navigation menu"), the element, and how to fix it. Checks cover broken links, image descriptions, leftover filler text, headings, search, accessibility and the share preview. Runs the check first if the page has none yet. On the Free plan, Search, Accessibility and Share preview problems are listed without the item-by-item detail. Not for PDFs.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

run_again.description: Run the check again now instead of reading the last result. Use it after publishing a new version. Default false.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List every version of a page: its number, when it was published, its name, how many comments were left on it, and who approved it or asked for changes on it. Use it when the user asks which version a client signed off, or before restoring an earlier version.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Bring back an earlier version of a page as a new version on the same review link. Nothing is deleted: every version and its comments stay in the version menu. Free pages keep up to 3 versions, so on Free this fails once a page has 3. Confirm the version number with the user first.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

version.description: The earlier version to bring back, as shown by list_versions.

notify_reviewers.description: Email everyone who commented that a new version is ready. Ask the user first. Default false.

note.description: Optional short note for that email.

tools.name: set_comment_status
tools.description: Change how a comment is tracked, the same way the HTMLAnnotate app does: its status (open, in progress, resolved), priority, labels and who it is assigned to. Pass only what should change. Resolving emails everyone in the thread, and assigning emails the person assigned. Labels replace the comment's current labels (up to 3).

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

labels.description: Optional. The labels the comment should have. An empty list clears them.

assignee.description: Optional. A teammate or reviewer on this page, by name or email. "none" unassigns it.

tools.name: update_page_settings
tools.description: Change a page's settings: the feedback due date (reviewers see it and get a reminder the day before), pausing or resuming new comments, and the page's name. Pass only what should change. The due date has to fall before the page's link expires (Free links last 14 days).

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

due_date.description: Optional. The feedback due date as YYYY-MM-DD, within the next year, or "none" to clear it.

timezone.description: Optional. The user's time zone, like Asia/Kolkata or America/New_York, so the due date ends at midnight for them. Defaults to UTC.

comments_paused.description: Optional. true pauses new comments and replies from reviewers (everyone can still read them); false lets them comment again.

title.description: Optional. A new name for the page, as shown in My projects and emails. The review link stays the same.
